note: First observed pre-match forecasts only. ROI uses recorded quotes, not executed bets. No automatic threshold fitting.

filter_comparison.note: Exploratory fixed profiles, not validated improvements. Includes rejected forecasts. Paper ROI at first recorded prices, no staking recommendation. Later-period data must not be used to tune profiles. No automatic live filter changes.

over15_ht_probability_comparison.note: Fixed exploratory rules include accepted and rejected predictions. Convergence is not a calibrated probability or a value recommendation. Only dates from validation_from are prospective; thresholds are never fitted automatically.
